catalog_url.label: Catalog URL
catalog_url.description: HTTP or HTTPS URL of one M3U, M3U8 or JSON radio catalog. Add another provider instance for another catalog.

refresh_interval.label: Refresh interval (minutes)
refresh_interval.description: Refresh this catalog every 1–1440 minutes. Other instances keep their own schedules. Use the provider's name field to give this catalog a friendly name.

errors.invalid_catalog_url: Enter an HTTP or HTTPS catalog URL without embedded credentials.
